flagged.title: Language & Dramatic Structure
flagged.reason: The video frames 'Hath not a Jew eyes?' as Shylock transitioning from prose to 'match your verse', reinforcing the mark-losing AO2 error of treating a prose monologue as verse.

mark_affecting.quote: He goes from being the prose-speaking outsider into this incredibly powerful rhythmic rhetoric... 'If I can match your verse, if I can speak just as beautifully and persuasively as you do...'
